parsed.post: The last attempt at increasing capacity (DEPTH=6) and tuning LR failed, causing significant regression to 1.182. Reverting to my previous best (commit 1cdbce0, val_bpb 1.092248). I suspect the learning rate of 0.1 is too aggressive for higher complexity; I will attempt to lower it and increase weight decay to improve stability.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate and increasing weight decay to stabilize training and prevent the divergence seen in the last experiment.
